scene.language: Okay, we have a scenario where two employees work at stations.[0][1][2] [3]One of them will raise their hand, this time sign that they need the object they are working on, we want them to bring it to them. The employee B raised their hand, so we want to bring them the red object. First we check in the basket, we see that the basket is empty, so we will bring them the object from the shelf. We lift the object and bring it to employee B.
